import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_77/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_77/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on "city"
# Join Source3_77_0 and Source3_77_1 on the "city" column
joined_df = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Operation 2: GROUP BY ["Source3_77_0.city", "Source3_77_1.type"], aggregation: avg(Source3_77_0.fare)
# Group by city and type, aggregate average fare from Source3_77_0 (fare column)
grouped_df = (
    joined_df.groupby(["city", "type"], as_index=False)
    .agg({"fare": "mean"})
)

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
# Target schema: ['city': string, 'type': string, 'fare': float]
grouped_df = grouped_df.rename(columns={"fare": "fare"})

# Ensure correct data types
grouped_df["city"] = grouped_df["city"].astype(str)
grouped_df["type"] = grouped_df["type"].astype(str)
grouped_df["fare"] = grouped_df["fare"].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_77/target_multisource.csv"
grouped_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_77/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_77/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on 'city' column (inner join by default)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by 'city' (primary key) and 'type' is functionally dependent on city, so we can take first
# Aggregate fare by average
result = joined.groupby("city", as_index=False).agg({
    "fare": "mean",
    "type": "first"
})

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
result = result[["city", "type", "fare"]]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_77/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
